map.间隙大了小了会怎样？: What happens if the clearance is too large or too small?
map.间隙过大断面毛刺大、塌角多；过小模具磨损快、易卡料。一般软料取料厚 5–8%、硬: Too large a clearance gives big burrs and many broken corners; too small one wears the die fast and causes sticking. For soft material take 5-8% of the thickness, for hard material 3-5%.
map.：单边间隙 c = 料厚×间隙率（如 5%×2 = 0.10mm），双边 z =: : one-side clearance c = thickness x clearance ratio (e.g. 5% x 2 = 0.10 mm), two-side z = 2 x 0.10 = 0.20 mm; the blanking force is about 5% and the push-piece force about 4%, i.e. 70x0.05≈3.5 kN and 70x0.04≈2.8 kN.
map.：周长 L=100mm、料厚 t=2mm、抗剪强度 τ=350MPa：理论冲裁力: : perimeter L=100 mm, thickness t=2 mm, shear strength τ=350 MPa: theoretical blanking force F = L*t*τ = 100*2*350 = 70,000 N = 70 kN; design force Fd = 70*1.3 = 91 kN (including the safety factor).
